title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure

title: A milestone in expanding access to AI

title: INSPIRE: An Internalize-Then-Improve Approach for Example-Driven Mathematical Reasoning
summary: 论文提出先内化示例、再改进推理的数学推理训练方法，关注如何让大模型从样例中稳定抽象解题策略。

title: A Survey on Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
summary: 综述梳理基于评分细则的语言模型强化学习，把 RLHF 之后的奖励设计、评价标准和训练流程系统化。

title: How Do Linear Probes Emerge? A Circuit-Tracing Framework with Concept-Targeted Attribution
summary: 论文用电路追踪和概念定向归因解释线性探针能力如何出现，试图把模型可解释性从相关性推进到机制层观察。

title: Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
summary: 研究面向扩散语言模型提出轨迹级 speculative decoding，以提高并行 token 生成场景下的推理效率。

title: When Tokenizers Fail: Byte-Level Chunking for Zero-Shot Transfer to Low-Resource Languages
summary: 论文指出子词分词会限制低资源语言迁移，并探索字节级分块来提升零样本跨语言泛化。

title: Knowing Before Answering: Decoding Language Models for Reliable RAG
summary: 研究关注 RAG 中检索信息不足时模型仍强行回答的问题，提出让模型在生成前判断知识是否充分的解码思路。

title: First Make It Playable, Then Make It Good: Staged Interaction Learning for Small Dialogue-Game Agents
summary: 论文介绍 Qwen-GuidePlay-2B，通过分阶段交互学习训练小型对话游戏 Agent，先保证可玩性再优化表现。

title: Below the Noise Floor: Bimodal Seed Collapse and Distinct Failure Modes in Small-Model Knowledge Distillation
summary: 研究小模型知识蒸馏中的种子坍缩和不同失败模式，提示蒸馏质量可能被随机初始化和任务路由细节显著影响。

title: CareGraph: An Auditable Hybrid AI Framework for Evidence-Grounded Personalized Longitudinal Health Intelligence
summary: CareGraph 提出可审计的混合 AI 健康智能框架，把个性化长期健康分析建立在证据链和可追溯决策之上。

title: Thinking Costs Tokens: When More Structure is Worth the Price
summary: 论文讨论在推理阶段加入搜索、验证等结构化步骤的 token 成本与收益，为何有些任务值得用更多计算换可靠性。

title: WM-R1: Training GUI Agents to Reason and leverage World Models with Reinforcement Learning
summary: WM-R1 用强化学习训练 GUI Agent 推理并利用世界模型，目标是提升真实界面任务中的规划和执行能力。

title: SETU: An Agentic Ecosystem for Multilingual, Persona-Aware Communication Coaching
summary: SETU 面向企业培训提出多语言、人物画像感知的沟通教练 Agent 生态，强调可解释和可扩展的训练流程。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator: A Compact Multimodal, Multilingual, and Reasoning Enabled Content Safety Moderator
summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 内容安全模型强调小型、多模态、多语言和推理能力，反映安全审核从文本过滤走向复杂上下文判断。

title: LongGuard: Mechanistic Analysis and Training-Free Mitigation of Long-Context Failure in Safety Guardrails
summary: LongGuard 分析长上下文下安全护栏失效的机制，并提出无需训练的缓解方法，适合长文档和 Agent 场景的风险控制。

title: Generative AI Expands the Intellectual Reach of Course Based Undergraduate Research Experiences (CUREs)
summary: 论文讨论生成式 AI 如何扩展本科生课程型研究体验，让更多学生参与研究设计、资料分析和跨学科探索。

title: If Agents Were Angels, No Governance Would Be Necessary: Out-of-Band Policy Enforcement at a Trusted Tool Boundary
summary: 论文主张在可信工具边界执行外部策略，而不是只依赖 Agent 自律，为高权限代理系统提供更工程化的治理思路。

title: Beyond Non-IID: Learner--Client Distribution Mismatch in Federated Learning
summary: 研究指出联邦学习中的问题不只是客户端数据非独立同分布，还包括学习器与客户端分布错配，影响部署效果评估。

title: Leveraging a Foundation Model for the EEG-Based Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease
summary: 论文探索用基础模型处理 EEG 数据辅助阿尔茨海默病诊断，体现医疗 AI 正从影像拓展到神经信号分析。

title: The Calls are Coming from Inside the Model: Investigating Probe-based Detection of Tool-Calling Errors in LLMs
summary: 研究用模型内部状态探针检测工具调用错误，希望在 Agent 执行外部操作前提前识别风险。

title: Node-wise Feature Encoding for Neural Performance Prediction

title: Actionable CBFI: Integrating Structural Decomposition and Causal Counterfactual Recourse for Tabular Machine Learning
summary: 研究把结构分解和因果反事实建议结合起来，为表格机器学习提供更可执行的解释和改进路径。

title: FedEHR-Agents: Federated Agentic Optimization for Automated EHR Modeling

title: Beyond Pairwise Graphs in Science: Hypergraph Adaptive Wavelet Operators for Parametric PDEs

title: There and Back Again: Bidirectional Diffusion Bridges for Multimodality Translation
